family: GTK2 GtkEntry face, text and relief comparison

change.summary: Maps GtkEntry base/text and its generated inset relief to KDE Window/WindowText roles, retaining KDE Selection/SelectionText for selected text. No final RGB values are embedded.

results.native_role_pixel_check: passed: interior sample matched the effective KDE Window role in all scenes

focused_comparison.difference: Motif reserves a 2px outer highlight before the 2px inset bevel. GTK2 currently starts its bevel at the allocation edge. The bevel tones differ by one RGB channel level from color quantization; font rendering was not compared because the local Xvfb Motif sample rendered the accented test string with the wrong charset.

results.public_preview: not run; native isolated fixture only
results.actual_vm: read-only snapshot was black except the Apollo command strip; no usable VUE text-field image. Launch args include frameskip 4 while live probe reports frameskip 0. No input or profile setting changed.

tests.native_scenes: 24 passed across 4 palettes x 3 states x 2 origins
tests.keyboard_clipboard: passed UTF-8, select/replace, Ctrl+C/V/X, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+Shift+Z, multi-step undo and native Edit popup actions

limits: The local Motif fixture and its library defaults do not establish HP VUE 2.01 / Domain/OS SR10.4 defaults.
The focus/highlight gutter is not yet reproduced in GtkEntry; the attempted 9px/11px pixmap with border4 suppressed the entire border in GTK2 and was discarded.
No public Theme Lab preview/controller route or personal XChat session was changed.
next: Continue the same GtkEntry family to resolve or bound the outer focus/highlight gutter; obtain a valid live SR10.4 VUE field capture before moving to another family.
